entities.name: Oraniad Mountains
entities.description: A volcanic mountain range east of Oreskos on Theros, said to be closer to Nyx than anywhere else.

entities.name: Oreskos
entities.description: Region west of the Oraniad Mountains.

entities.name: Nykthos
entities.description: Temple at the summit of Mount Carian, a nexus between the mortal world and Nyx, with altars to every god.

entities.name: Nykthos (Nyxborn)
entities.description: The first Nyxborn, who built the temple of Nykthos.

entities.name: Mount Carian
entities.description: One of the tallest Oraniad peaks, housing Nykthos at its summit.

entities.name: The Empty Eye
entities.description: Extinct volcano on the western edge, said to conceal a passage to the Underworld.

entities.name: The Phoenix Stairs
entities.description: Volcanic peak reached by hexagonal basalt columns where a phoenix guards its nest.

entities.name: The Winter's Heart
entities.description: Glacial volcano in the northern Oraniads with a glass statue offering a diamond crown.

entities.name: Nyx
entities.description: Divine realm the mountains are said to rise close to.

relations.quote: The Oraniad Mountains stretch along the eastern edge of Oreskos
Mount Carian is best known for housing Nykthos at its summit.
built by the first Nyxborn of the same name
